items.title: Etihad Rail Begins Abu Dhabi–Fujairah Passenger Service
items.summary: The UAE's national rail operator opened its first public passenger route on 30 June, the start of a phased rollout set to connect 11 cities across the country.

items.title: Saudi Arabia Scales Back NEOM's Trojena Development
items.summary: A planned artificial lake, dam and winter sports resort at the $500bn NEOM site have been scrapped as Riyadh recalibrates the giga-project's scope.

items.title: Expo 2030 Riyadh Marks Major Delivery Milestone
items.summary: Organisers report 6.2 million cubic metres of earthworks complete and 77% of development plots handed over as utility corridors and metro links take shape.

items.title: Qatar's Ashghal Unveils $3.1bn Infrastructure Package
items.summary: The Public Works Authority has awarded a fresh wave of roads, drainage and public-facility contracts as part of its ongoing national infrastructure pipeline.

items.title: Gulf Rail Push: Muscat Metro and Hafeet Rail Advance
items.summary: Oman's Muscat Metro and the 238km Oman–UAE Hafeet Rail link highlight a region-wide bet on rail infrastructure supporting Vision 2040 and cross-border trade.

items.title: GCC Construction Equipment Demand Set to Hit Record Highs
items.summary: Vision 2030 diversification and post-World Cup legacy projects are projected to lift regional machinery investment through 2031, led by excavators, loaders and cranes.

items.title: Nemetschek Completes HCSS Acquisition to Boost GCC Construction Tech
items.summary: The completed acquisition brings advanced project-management and fleet software to construction firms across the Middle East, accelerating digital transformation on site.
